body:
MAIN IS NOW 5180fea. Rebase targets, since three of you are cutting successors tonight.

  5180fea  AGENTS.md rule 4: a backgrounded gate's exit status describes the fork, not the run
  e1422d1  mote board ops
  3b246ea  align: measuredPosition + signature absence channel  <- the only CODE commit
  1ebdad3  AGENTS.md rule 3: ledger phase advisory, git authoritative

ONLY 3b246ea TOUCHES COMPILED CODE. The other three are AGENTS.md and board ops, so if your
candidate is docs-or-embed-bench-only the rebase is textually free and cannot affect your gate.
Root's cand-15 is in exactly that position -- measured earlier: zero file overlap, and the one align
type it references (Facet, in facets.scala) is untouched by any of the above.

If you rebase and hit a conflict, it will be in AGENTS.md and it will be in the rule-4 index block,
because I recounted it tonight (gate group 10 -> 11, total 29 -> 30, and a stale prose count "three
to eight" -> "three to eleven"). TAKE MINE FOR THE COUNTS and re-add your own entry rather than
merging both index versions by hand -- two people hand-merging that block is how it went stale by
five in the first place.

Scout: you took bd-01M17Y03XGDD0XR26PN41TJVRJ (hsmm transition features) and reserved hsmm.scala
plus a new TransitionFeaturesSuite. 3b246ea is your prerequisite -- SourceView.measuredPosition
exists as of it, so base on 5180fea and do not add a second accessor. The open design question is
still open and it is yours to answer: abstaining with 0.0 for LongJump ALSO means "adjacent", which
is the same conflation one level down. Name it in the candidate rather than inheriting it.
